palette: Shared sound palette for the whole game: glockenspiel, celesta, marimba, sleigh bells, soft felt piano, warm toy brass, plucky bass, wooden toy percussion, and puffy snow foley. Cozy, warm, toy-like winter; never harsh, metallic, realistic or scary.
style: One consistent set: every sound must feel like it comes from the same world. Use the shared palette. Tonal sounds in D major (the North, boss and finale music in D minor). Effects are short and dry (no big reverb, a small room at most), start instantly with no silence at the front, and contain no music or voices unless the item asks for them.
rights: Use a Fish Audio paid plan: paid plans include commercial rights; the free tier's terms aren't stated.
about: Remakes every effect the game has today, so the whole game is one set. Same palette, style and packaging as part 1. Make part 2 after part 1 has been heard and approved.
order: 1) the 8 priority-A effects, then send those to the account owner for Alex to hear in the game before going on; 2) the 6 voice lines (Fish Audio text to speech); 3) the B and C effects.

deliver.format: WAV, 44.1 kHz, 16-bit. WAV is lossless, and MP3 adds silence at the start and end that breaks seamless loops. The game's final MP3s are made from these.
deliver.takes: Deliver every take, numbered: <name>_1.wav, <name>_2.wav, <name>_3.wav. Don't pick a favourite; we choose by listening in the game.
deliver.manifest: manifest.csv in the zip root, one row per file: file,type,take,seconds_actual,prompt_used,notes
deliver.problems: If the tool can't make an item exactly as written, stop and tell the account owner. Don't swap in something else.

items.name: click
items.when: Every button tap.
items.prompt: Soft rounded UI tap, a tiny wooden toy click with a hint of a high bell, very short, clean, cozy mobile game button, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: buy
items.when: Buying an upgrade or anything in the shop.
items.prompt: Cheerful purchase chime: a quick coin clink then two rising bright bell notes in D major, satisfying, cozy and toy-like, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: coin
items.when: Picking up coins in a job (the game varies the pitch).
items.prompt: Single bright coin pickup ding, small and sparkly, a tiny bell with a coin clink, very short, video game, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: bump
items.when: Bumping into a prop.
items.prompt: Soft cartoon bump into a snow-covered object, a puffy thud with a tiny wooden knock, playful, not painful, very short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: hit
items.when: Getting hit by a hazard: a car, a snowball, a dog.
items.prompt: Cartoon hit by a snowball: a soft puffy splat-thump with a little comedic boing, not violent, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: combo
items.when: Each combo step (the game raises the pitch step by step, so keep it one note).
items.prompt: Single bright marimba note on D with a tiny sparkle, clean attack, short, video game combo counter, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: go
items.when: A job starts.
items.prompt: Cheerful start signal: a bright toy whistle toot followed by a quick rising bell flourish in D major, energetic, short, dry

items.name: win
items.when: Job finished with a clean sweep.
items.prompt: Job complete fanfare: a short joyful toy brass and glockenspiel flourish in D major ending on a bright chord, cozy winter celebration, no voice, dry

items.name: end
items.when: Job finished when the time runs out.
items.prompt: Time's up: a friendly whistle toot and a soft bell phrase in D major that dips and then resolves, not sad, gently wraps up, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: star1
items.when: First star appears on the results.
items.prompt: First reward star appears: a single warm glockenspiel note on D with a soft sparkle, satisfying, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: star2
items.when: Second star.
items.prompt: Second reward star: a single bright glockenspiel note on F sharp with a sparkle, a little brighter than the first, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: star3
items.when: Third star.
items.prompt: Third reward star: a bright glockenspiel note on high A with an extra shimmer and a tiny chime chord, triumphant, short, dry

items.name: gift
items.when: Opening a present in a job.
items.prompt: Present opening: a soft paper rustle and ribbon pop, then a bright happy two-note chime in D major, cozy winter, short, dry

items.name: engine
items.when: Machine engine while driving (the game pitches it per machine and speed).
items.prompt: Small cozy diesel engine chugging steadily, toy-like and warm, even and continuous, no revving, seamless loop

items.name: scrape_l
items.when: A big machine's blade scraping snow.
items.prompt: Steady snow plow blade scraping across packed snow, a smooth continuous shhh with soft crunch texture, even, seamless loop

items.name: scrape_s
items.when: The kid's shovel, pusher and blower scraping snow.
items.prompt: Snow shovel pushing light snow, a soft continuous scrape with gentle crunch, even, seamless loop

items.name: deny
items.when: Can't afford it or not allowed.
items.prompt: Gentle no sound: two soft descending wooden blips, friendly not harsh, very short, cozy UI, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: grab
items.when: Grabbing spilled coins back.
items.prompt: Quick light coin snatch, a soft whoosh into a tiny coin clink, very short, playful, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: spill
items.when: Coins spilling out after a crash.
items.prompt: A small handful of coins scattering onto snow, soft jingly tumble muffled by snow, short, playful, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: cfade
items.when: Your combo is about to run out.
items.prompt: Soft descending two-note warning blip on a muted glockenspiel, gentle, short, video game, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: cend
items.when: Combo lost.
items.prompt: Deflating combo: a short descending three-note toy xylophone slide with a soft puff, a little sad but cute, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: tick

items.prompt: Single crisp clock tick, wooden and toy-like, very short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: warn
items.when: A hazard is about to come in.
items.prompt: Short friendly alert: two quick high soft beeps like a toy walkie-talkie, gets attention but not alarming, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: time
items.when: A present that gives extra time.
items.prompt: Magic time bonus: a quick clock wind-up followed by a bright sparkle chime in D major, short, playful, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: gold

items.prompt: Gold rush: a shimmering cascade of golden bells and coins rising in D major, exciting and sparkly, short, cozy, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: fanfare
items.when: Big moments without their own sound (a Wild Ride is yours, and so on).
items.prompt: Big reward fanfare: a bright toy trumpet and glockenspiel flourish in D major with a sleigh-bell shimmer, celebratory, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: trophy
items.when: A trophy unlocked.
items.prompt: Trophy unlocked: a sparkling chime arpeggio rising in D major ending on a bell ding, proud and cozy, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: daily
items.when: A daily goal completed.
items.prompt: Task complete: a cheerful tick chime, two quick rising bell notes and a soft sparkle in D major, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: squall

items.prompt: A gust of wintry wind rising quickly with swirling snow, a soft whoosh building up, cozy not scary, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: flump

items.prompt: A big soft pile of snow dropping: a heavy powdery flump, muffled and satisfying, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: splat
items.when: A snowball lands.
items.prompt: Snowball splat on snow: a soft crunchy splat, playful, very short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: neighbour
items.when: You cleared a neighbour's path and she walks out happy.
items.prompt: A warm doorbell ding-dong in D major with a little sparkle, grateful and cozy, short, no voice, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: throw

items.prompt: Quick snowball throw: a short airy whoosh with a tiny hand pat, very short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: whoosh
items.when: A sled or skier rushing in.
items.prompt: A fast sled whooshing past: a quick airy swoosh with a light snow hiss, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: carhorn
items.when: A car or taxi honks (replaces horn.mp3; the Icebreaker's ship horn is horn.mp3 in part 1).
items.prompt: Cartoon car horn: one short friendly honk like a toy car, bright, not aggressive, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: moo
items.when: The UFO beams up a cow.
items.prompt: Cartoon cow moo rising in pitch as it is beamed up, with a soft sci-fi warble, funny, short, dry

items.name: crunch
items.when: The Monster Truck crushes junk.
items.prompt: A monster truck crushing a small object: a chunky toy crunch with a little metal crumple, playful and satisfying, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: stomp
items.when: The Mega Mech's footsteps; getting spun out by a chaser.
items.prompt: A heavy toy robot footstep: a soft metallic stomp with a muffled snow thud, playful, short, dry, the sound happens right at the start, then silence

items.name: jet
items.when: The Jet Truck blowing snow.
items.prompt: Cartoon jet turbine blowing snow, a steady airy roar, playful not loud, even, seamless loop

items.name: fire
items.when: The Snow Dragon's breath melting snow.
items.prompt: Soft dragon fire breath, a steady warm crackling flame whoosh with a hiss of melting snow, playful, even, seamless loop

items.name: beam
items.when: The UFO's beam.
items.prompt: A friendly UFO tractor beam hum, a soft warbling sci-fi tone with a gentle shimmer, cozy not scary, even, seamless loop

lengths: Fish Audio takes whole seconds (1 s minimum). Ask for request_seconds; the sound plays at the very start and the rest is silence. Deliver it untrimmed: it's trimmed to trim_to when it goes into the game.
music: Not made in Fish Audio (its generator does ambience, foley and impacts, not music). The music is made separately.
